## ITKbCols type

Keyboard column configuration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITKbCols = `${1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6}` | `${1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6}-${1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6}`;
```

## Remarks

Defines the number of columns for keyboard button layout. Can be: - Single number: `"1"` to `"6"` - All buttons in that many columns - Range format: `"min-max"` - Responsive columns between min and max (e.g., `"2-4"`<!-- -->)

## Example


```typescript
// Fixed 3 columns
const cols1: IKbCols = "3"

// Responsive 2-4 columns
const cols2: IKbCols = "2-4"
```
